segments.caption: Let’s read this together. A school library should stay open after classes. Students who share a quiet space at home with other family members need somewhere to study. An after-school library gives them access to a calm workspace.
Here’s the claim, separated from its support.
This sentence gives a reason: some students need a quiet place to study.
The link is access: opening the library creates a calm workspace. Select any card and ask me about that part.
Let’s find how steep the line is between point A, at one comma two, and point B, at four comma eight.
Start with change in y divided by change in x. The two x coordinates must be different.
Substitute the coordinates: eight minus two over four minus one. That becomes six over three.
Your turn. Complete m equals six divided by three, and tell me how you got there. I’ll wait.
We’ve kept your submitted work beside the derivation. The slope describes vertical change for one unit of horizontal change.
Start with the learner. We’ll build this relationship map one part at a time.
The learner uses an app. Here’s that second node.
Connect the learner to the app. The arrow names the relationship.
Shared computing resources sit behind the app. One relationship is still missing.
Add the missing relationship. You can also rename or move a node. The source explains what each arrow means.
Your diagram is preserved. Read each arrow as a sentence, including its direction.
